scientific_integrity: The proof and its finite exact-rational checker are supplied. Signed dyadic doubling and Bernoulli-shift theory are established ingredients, not claimed as new. Novelty is assessed against accessible evidence, and independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Statements are Lebesgue-almost-everywhere and do not classify exceptional threshold itineraries.
The result does not classify nonuniform invariant measures or all positive alternating gains.
The closed-form central limit theorem concerns paired sums, not arbitrary observables.
A relevant 2015 same-model periodic-orbit paper was not fully accessible for comparison.
scientific_scope: Period-two McCulloch–Pitts threshold neuron on (-1,1), distinct gains in [1,2], phase-uniform Lebesgue invariant probability; exact all-lag covariance and paired-sum fluctuations for the order (2,1).
title: Uniform-marginal rigidity and alternating correlation reversal in a periodic threshold neuron
